purpose: The one list of what the installed Windows archive must pass. The workflow runs exactly these modules, tools/require_acceptance_results.py refuses a results.xml that lacks any of them, and tools/astra6_freeze.py refuses to freeze on anything less. Counting is per module: repetitions of one test never add up to a profile.

binding.rule: Every report names the source SHA it tested, the SHA-256 of the application ZIP it ran, the workflow run that produced it and the SHA of the checkout that drove it. A report without all four, or with a different value in any, is not evidence for this candidate.
